chapter: Learning clarinet and the Eureka band
title: Bunk Johnson's Philadelphia concert band, why he took up clarinet, and learning
summary: He recalls a photo of the band at the Academy of Music in Philadelphia, then talks about being drawn to music, a childhood violin, and playing funerals on clarinet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
